subject: Invoice submission routing — intake form options, portal vs SMTP fallback
messages:
From: BrightWave Billing <billing@brightwave.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Liu <sara.liu@brightwave.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T09:12:00Z
Subject: New vendor onboarding — invoice submission options

Hi Monica,

We're getting ready to send our first invoices to Redwood after the 8/1 go-live. Before we start, can you confirm Redwood's preferred intake method and share the minimal invoice template we should use?

Currently we produce both: a single PDF per invoice (human-readable) and a compact CSV export (one row per line item). We also have an internal PO-stamping process that puts a Redwood PO number into the PDF header when present.

Two specific asks:
- Do you prefer portal uploads, or should we send invoices over SMTP to billing@redwood.com as a fallback?
- If SMTP is used, what subject/header tokens or file-naming conventions trigger automatic ingestion and ack?

I've attached a sample PDF and CSV for reference.

Thanks — Sara
Billing Ops | BrightWave Inc.
attachments: brightwave-sample-invoice.pdf (pdf), brightwave-csv-example.csv (csv)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: BrightWave Billing <billing@brightwave.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T09:46:00Z
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — invoice submission options

Hi Sara — thanks for sending the samples, they were helpful. High level guidance below (short version first, details after):

Short answer:
- Portal first (preferred): single-invoice PDF OR line-item CSV both supported.
- SMTP fallback accepted, but follow the subject/file-name conventions below and include the RW-INVOICE-ACK token in the email body to ensure automated ack.

Details / mapping guidance:
1) Portal onboarding (recommended)- Use our vendor onboarding portal to register and upload invoices. Portal advantages: immediate structured ack, PO visibility, and faster AP matching. We provide a one-click mapping form during activation that maps your CSV columns to our ledger fields. Link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cRW_onboarding-form (sample onboarding form).

2) CSV vs PDF rules- CSV (preferred for high-volume recurring invoices): compact single row per line item, header row required, columns: vendor_invoice_id, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), po_number (if present), line_description, quantity, unit_price, tax_amount, total_amount, currency. If you send CSV, add a subject prefix of "CSV-INVOICE:" followed by vendor_invoice_id (see examples below).
- PDF: accepted for one-off invoices or legal attachments. When sending PDF by SMTP, include a machine-readable filename: <vendor_invoice_id>_RWPO<po_number>_YYYYMMDD.pdf when PO exists; otherwise <vendor_invoice_id>_YYYYMMDD.pdf.

3) SMTP fallback and ack tokens- Email to: billing@redwood.com with subject conventions to enable automated ingestion:
  * CSV subject example: CSV-INVOICE: BW-20260815-00123
  * PDF subject example: PDF-INVOICE: BW-20260815-00123
- In the email body include: RW-INVOICE-ACK: <your-system-id> (this is an id you generate; we'll return an ack token in 1–2 minutes). If RW-INVOICE-ACK is not present, the message is queued for manual triage (longer turnaround).
- If you need an immediate machine-readable ack, put the token on the first line of the body like: RW-INVOICE-ACK: BW-BILL-00003

4) PO stamping and multi-PO invoices- If your PDF has multiple POs on separate pages, include a CSV manifest in the same message that maps invoice line ranges to PO numbers. Example manifest filename: BW-20260815-00123_manifest.csv. We can accept multi-PO PDFs but multi-PO handling increases manual review risk; CSV with explicit PO column is the cleanest path.

5) Attachments and size limits- Portal: up to 25MB per file. SMTP: 12MB per message; zipped archives allowed. Large batches = portal preferred.

Examples (paste these in subject and first body line):
Subject: CSV-INVOICE: BW-20260815-00123
Body first line: RW-INVOICE-ACK: BW-BILL-00003
Attachment: BW-20260815-00123.csv

Subject: PDF-INVOICE: BW-20260815-00124
Body first line: RW-INVOICE-ACK: BW-BILL-00004
Attachment: BW-20260815-00124_RWPO98765.pdf

I've attached a short one-page onboarding checklist (in the Drive link) and a CSV header spec. Vanessa — I pasted the CSV header spec below as well to make it easy to copy into activation docs.

CSV header (exact): vendor_invoice_id,invoice_date,po_number,line_description,quantity,unit_price,tax_amount,total_amount,currency

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Procurement Partner | Redwood Inference

From: BrightWave Billing <billing@brightwave.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Liu <sara.liu@brightwave.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T10:25:00Z
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — invoice submission options

Monica — this is super helpful, thank you. A couple follow-ups from our ops team after reviewing the CSV template: 

1) Currency column: our export sometimes leaves currency blank for USD. Will a missing currency default to USD?
2) PO visibility: can you confirm whether the portal will accept a PO in the filename only (no po_number column) if the value is present in the PDF header? We want to avoid changing our internal PO-stamping until activation is complete.
3) Ack timing: what's the SLA for automated ack when RW-INVOICE-ACK is included? We test workflows and need to ensure banks and AP connectors see timely confirmation.

Also attaching the sample CSV our system generates (brightwave-csv-example.csv) so you can confirm column order matches.

— Sara

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: BrightWave Billing <billing@brightwave.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T12:03:00Z
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — invoice submission options

Hi Sara — quick answers below, and Jordan I'm looping you for PO-to-ledger mapping verification.

1) Currency default: yes — if currency is blank we default to USD. Please document this on your side; we'll add a validation warning in the portal if currency is omitted.

2) PO visibility: portal can accept PO in filename or PDF header during the activation pilot, but for automated ingestion we prefer po_number in CSV. For SMTP/PDF fallback we will attempt to extract the PO from the filename/pattern RWPO\d+ and from the first page header; if extraction fails we'll queue for manual review. So keep PO-stamping in place for now, but include po_number column in CSV for production reliability.

3) Ack SLA: automated ack when RW-INVOICE-ACK token is present — we aim to respond with an ack token within 2 minutes during business hours (PST); worst-case 15 minutes if the message hits our burst queue. Portal ack is immediate.

Next steps:
- Sara: please upload one test CSV to the portal (sandbox) using the CSV header I pasted earlier and we will confirm mapping and ack flow.
- Jordan: can you confirm the ledger field "external_invoice_id" will accept the vendor_invoice_id format BW-YYYYMMDD-xxxxx? If not, suggest a mapping rule.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Procurement Partner | Redwood Inference
